resource: Rows of one (World, category, vocation filter) highscore list
allocation_impact: Each of the six filter lists is capped after filtering the complete eligible cut, so a snapshot holds at most 6,000 rows (SQL CHECK row_count <= 6000 and position <= 1000); global ranks may exceed the cap.
boundary_tests: max=1000: a filtered list keeps its 1,000th member
max+1=1001: the 1,001st member is not stored and has no own row
